summary: preinstall hook exfiltrates host identifiers to Burp Collaborator endpoint
details: package.json declares a `preinstall` script that runs `node index.js` on `npm install`. index.js collects host identifiers (os.hostname(), os.platform(), os.arch(), os.homedir(), dns.getServers()) and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded host `f4k2mnpoengdb7o3etftn7fmkdq5ew5ku.oastify.com` (a Burp Collaborator out-of-band interaction endpoint). The beacon fires automatically on install without user interaction and self-describes as a dependency-confusion proof of concept.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
